verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe Sessions-based Checkout API embedding, client-side components with customizable styling and localization across web/iOS/Android/RN/Flutter (adyen-docs-1, adyen-docs-14, adyen-docs-15, adyen-docs-19), directly supporting embedded, customizable payment UI rather than a hosted redirect. However, community reports describe the integration as complex and less turnkey than competitors (adyen-comm-5, adyen-comm-9), suggesting real-world friction in achieving this embedding smoothly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the embedded components working seamlessly, and clearer distinction from Adyen's own hosted/payment-links option (adyen-docs-24) which is also offered as an alternative.
